about_the_game:
Trapped on a deadly island. Hunted by your past. Only one choice: survive. Perished Truth is an adrenaline-fueled single-player survival horror game, blending classic "Resident Evil" and "Saw" influences with a modern, intense twist.

Story

Shinji Ueda's life was shattered after the death of his wife. Desperate to save his terminally ill daughter from sharing the same fate as her mother, he turned to the dark web, crossing paths with forces far more dangerous than he ever imagined. Now, hunted for sins he thought he left behind, Shinji wakes up trapped on a desolate island with nine other strangers, each hiding dark secrets of their own. To survive, he must endure a series of twisted trials... where failure means death.

Gameplay

Perished Truth fuses classic fixed-camera, tank-control survival horror with modernized controls and aiming. Customize your experience to play your way. Explore a forgotten island, scavenge for weapons and supplies, and face off against the infected, and possibly, your fellow captives. Solve environmental puzzles, unlock new paths, and piece together the truth behind your captors... before time runs out and you become one of the infected.

Features

  • Classic survival horror tension with modernized controls

  • Fixed camera angles with optional shoulder-camera perspective and first-person aiming

  • Crafting, inventory management, weapon upgrading, resource scavenging

  • Twisted puzzles with rewarding outcomes

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) / Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i5-7500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 with 4GB VRAM / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti with 4GB VRAM
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) / Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7 8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070

short_description: Inspired by classic "Resident Evil" and "Saw", prepare for an adrenaline-fueled survival horror following the story of Shinji Ueda, a struggling father who finds himself the subject of a twisted series of life-or-death trials. Fend off ravenous zombies, solve puzzles, and escape the trials...alive.

English*, French, Italian, German, Czech, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
